widget.name: MxGantt
widget.description: A Gantt chart over a data source of tasks: an editable task list next to a zoomable timeline with groups, milestones, progress, baselines and typed dependencies. Users reschedule tasks by dragging or with the keyboard, optionally with auto-scheduling on a working calendar; the new values are written to the objects.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: The tasks to show, one bar per object. Sort it in the data source: rows keep the order they are given, grouped by the Group attribute when one is set.

property.caption: Task name
property.description: The name shown in the task list and next to the bar, usually just the task's Name attribute.

property.caption: Code
property.description: Optional short code shown before the name in the task list, such as a project number. Searched like the name.

property.caption: Second line
property.description: Optional smaller text under the name in the task list, such as the project manager and a grade. With a second line rows are at least 52 pixels high. Searched like the name.

property.caption: Start
property.description: When the task starts. Written back when the user moves the bar or drags its start.

property.caption: End
property.description: When the task ends. A task that ends when it starts is drawn as a milestone. Written back when the user moves the bar or drags its end.

property.caption: Progress
property.description: Optional percentage done, 0 to 100, drawn as the filled part of the bar. Users can drag the progress handle to change it.

property.caption: Load at most
property.description: 0 loads every task the data source returns. A number such as 500 loads that many tasks first and shows a Load more button, which keeps very large plans quick to open.

property.caption: Group
property.description: Optional phase or parent name. Tasks with the same value are shown under a collapsible group row with a summary bar; tasks without a value are shown on their own.

property.caption: Milestone
property.description: Optional flag that draws the task as a diamond at its start date. Tasks that end when they start are milestones anyway.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Optional bar colour as any CSS colour, such as #2f6fed or teal. Empty or invalid values use the default bar colour.

property.caption: Status
property.description: Optional status of the task, such as an enumeration OnTrack, AtRisk, Short. Each value listed in Status colours gives the bar that colour (before Colour) and, with a legend text, a line in the legend under the chart.

property.caption: Status colours
property.description: The bar colour and legend text per Status value. Values not listed keep the normal colour.

property.caption: Value
property.description: The Status value: the enumeration key (or its caption), the text, or true / false. Not case-sensitive.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Any CSS colour, such as #e5242b or orange. The finished part is drawn in this colour, the rest in a lighter tint of it.

property.caption: Legend text
property.description: Optional line in the legend under the chart, such as Capacity need will not be met. Empty leaves the value out of the legend.

property.caption: Key
property.description: Optional unique key of the task that other tasks refer to in their Depends on attribute, such as a task number.

property.caption: Depends on
property.description: Optional comma-separated keys of the tasks this one depends on, such as 3, 5. A plain key is finish to start; add a type and a lag for other links: 3SS (start to start), 5FF+2d (finish to finish two days later), 7SF, 4FS-1d (a day's lead), 6FS+4h or 8SS+1w. Tasks that break a link are flagged as conflicts. Needs the Key attribute.

property.caption: Baseline start
property.description: Optional planned start, drawn with Baseline end as a thin bar under the task so slippage is visible.

property.caption: Baseline end
property.description: Optional planned end. The tooltip and the Variance column show how many (working) days the task ends later or earlier than planned.

property.caption: Assigned to
property.description: Optional person or team doing the task; several are separated by commas. Used for the Assigned to column, the resource workload panel, colouring by assignee and the My tasks filter.

property.caption: Deadline
property.description: Optional date the task must be finished by. A small flag marks it on the row; tasks that end after it get a warning, a tooltip line with the overrun in (working) days and count as missed deadlines in the project health strip.

property.caption: Assignments
property.description: Optional resources with units, such as Ann:50, Bob for Ann half time and Bob full time (100 when no number is given). Used by the resource usage panel, levelling and costs instead of Assigned to, and editable in a Resources column with Inline editing.

property.caption: Segments
property.description: Optional String attribute (unlimited length) for split tasks: the work segments as working days after the start, such as 0-2, 4-7. The widget writes it when users split a task, drag a segment or join the segments; empty means the task is not split.

property.caption: Constraint type
property.description: Optional constraint: ASAP, ALAP, SNET, SNLT, FNET, FNLT, MSO or MFO, the long names (Start no earlier than) or MS Project numbers 0-7; enumeration keys or captions both work. Auto-scheduling and Schedule plan honour it; broken constraints are flagged.

property.caption: Constraint date
property.description: The date of the constraint; needed by every type except as soon / late as possible.

property.caption: Priority
property.description: Optional priority 0-1000 as in MS Project (500 when empty). Resource levelling keeps higher priorities in place first; 1000 is never levelled.

property.caption: Baselines (JSON)
property.description: Optional String attribute (unlimited length) holding up to ten named baselines per task as JSON. Adds a Baselines toolbar button: choose which baseline the chart shows, compare two, and save or delete baselines. Baseline start and Baseline end keep working as the baseline called Baseline (attributes).

property.caption: Project
property.description: Optional project of the task for the portfolio view, usually the name over an association such as Task_Project/Project/Name. With a project, every project gets a collapsible summary row with its groups and tasks under it, and dependencies may cross projects.

property.caption: Working days
property.description: Optional working days as ISO weekday numbers (1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday) or names, such as 1-5 or Mon-Thu, Sat. Empty: every day counts. With working days, durations and lags are counted in working days and non-working days are shaded.

property.caption: Holidays
property.description: Optional non-working dates as yyyy-mm-dd, separated by commas or spaces, with ranges written 2026-12-24..2026-12-31. Can use parameters, for example to read the list from a configuration object.

property.caption: Skip non-working days
property.description: When tasks are dragged or moved with the keyboard (day snapping), they never start or end on a non-working day and keep their working duration.

property.caption: Auto-schedule
property.description: When a task moves later, pushes the tasks that depend on it (and theirs) so no link is broken, respecting lags and working days. The moved tasks are previewed while dragging and saved together. Off and On add a toolbar button that switches it, starting off or on; None leaves it out. Needs Key and Depends on.

property.caption: Schedule plan button
property.description: A Schedule plan toolbar button that places every task with predecessors as early as its links, lags, constraint and the calendar allow (and as late as possible tasks as late as allowed), shows the result on the chart and applies it as one undo step. Needs Key and Depends on.

property.caption: Resources
property.description: Optional list of resources (people, teams, machines) with their maximum units and cost rate. Resources named in Assignments that are not in this list count as one person (100%) without cost.

property.caption: Resource name
property.description: The name as it is written in Assignments or Assigned to.

property.caption: Max units (%)
property.description: How much the resource can do at once, in percent: 100 for one person full time, 50 for half time, 300 for a team of three. Above it the resource is over-allocated. 100 when empty.

property.caption: Cost rate per hour
property.description: Standard cost of an hour of work of the resource, for task costs and earned value.

property.caption: Hours per working day
property.description: Working hours in a day, to turn hourly cost rates into the cost of a working day.

property.caption: Fixed cost
property.description: Optional cost of the task on top of its resources' work, such as licences or materials.

property.caption: Actual cost
property.description: Optional cost booked on the task so far (AC). Without it the actual cost is estimated as the current cost times the progress.

property.caption: Currency
property.description: ISO 4217 code such as EUR or USD to format costs; empty shows plain numbers.

property.caption: On import
property.description: Adds an Import MS Project toolbar button. The chosen Microsoft Project XML file is read in the browser, previewed, and handed over as JSON in the attribute below; this action then imports it, typically a microflow with an Import with mapping. The widget never creates objects itself.

property.caption: Import: JSON
property.description: String attribute (unlimited length) of the data view object that receives the imported plan as JSON before On import runs. The README describes the JSON structure.

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Whether a task can be moved, resized or have its progress changed. Use an expression on the task to lock individual tasks, for example $currentObject/Status != 'Done', or false for a read-only chart.

property.caption: Snap to
property.description: The step dates move in when dragging or using the arrow keys.

property.caption: Save changes
property.description: Commit saves the changed task straight away. Change only updates the object in the client and leaves saving to the On task changed action, for example a microflow that validates and commits.

property.caption: Undo and redo
property.description: Adds Undo and Redo toolbar buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y for every change made in the chart, including a task and the successors it pushed. Adding and deleting tasks run app actions and cannot be undone here.

property.caption: Edit in task list
property.description: Lets users edit start, end, duration, progress and (with Name attribute) the name, and with Depends on the predecessors, right in the task list: double-click a cell, or press F2 on a task.

property.caption: Name attribute
property.description: Optional attribute that holds the task name, so it can be edited in the task list. Usually the attribute the Task name shows.

property.caption: Edit dependencies
property.description: Lets users add a dependency by dragging from the dot at the end of a bar onto another bar (or pressing L, then Enter on the other task), and remove one from the right-click menu (or the context menu key). Writes the Depends on attribute. Needs Key and Depends on.

property.caption: Depends on attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the Depends on attribute, such as DependsOn. Only needed when saving a dependency reports that the attribute could not be found, which can happen while no task has any dependency yet.

property.caption: Assignments attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the Assignments attribute. Only needed when its name does not contain Assign or Resource and saving reports that the attribute could not be found.

property.caption: Segments attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the Segments attribute. Only needed when its name does not contain Segment or Split and saving reports that the attribute could not be found.

property.caption: Baselines attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the Baselines (JSON) attribute. Only needed when its name does not contain Baseline and saving reports that the attribute could not be found.

property.caption: Save baselines
property.description: With Baselines (JSON), users can save the current plan as a named baseline and delete baselines from the Baselines panel. Off: baselines can only be shown and compared.

property.caption: What-if scenarios
property.description: Adds a Plan a scenario toolbar toggle. While it is on, drags, resizes, edits and auto-scheduling only change a copy inside the widget: changed bars are outlined and a summary shows the new end date and how many tasks moved. Apply saves all changes at once (with Save changes and On task changed as usual); Discard throws them away.

property.caption: On task changed
property.description: Runs on the task after the user has moved or resized it or changed its progress and the new values are set, for example to validate, commit or reschedule successors.

property.caption: On task click
property.description: Runs when the user clicks a bar or a task name, or presses Enter on a focused bar, for example to open the task in a pop-up page.

property.caption: On add task
property.description: Adds an Add task toolbar button (and the Insert key). Before it runs, the suggested start and end (after the focused task, or today) are written to the attributes below on the object of the surrounding data view, so a microflow or nanoflow can create the task from them.

property.caption: Add: start
property.description: Optional DateTime attribute of the data view object that receives the suggested start before On add task runs.

property.caption: Add: end
property.description: Optional DateTime attribute of the data view object that receives the suggested end (one working day after the start) before On add task runs.

property.caption: On delete task
property.description: Adds Delete task to the toolbar and the task menu (and the Delete key). Runs on the task after the user confirms, typically a Delete object action or a microflow that also cleans up dependencies.

property.caption: Custom fields
property.description: Lets users add their own task list columns in the running app (text, number, currency, percent, date, single and multi select with colours, checkbox, person, link, rating and formula), edit the values in the list, and choose and reorder the columns. Needs Fields and Task values.

property.caption: Fields
property.description: String attribute (unlimited length) of the data view object around the widget, usually the project, that holds the field definitions as JSON. Everyone who opens this object sees the same fields. The README describes the JSON.

property.caption: Task values
property.description: String attribute (unlimited length) of the task that holds its custom field values as JSON, keyed by field key. Written with the Save changes setting, like dates and progress.

property.caption: Task values attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the Task values attribute, such as FieldValues. Only needed when saving a value reports that the attribute could not be found, which can happen while no task has values yet and the name does not contain Field, Custom or Values.

property.caption: Users can manage fields
property.description: Whether the user may add, rename, change and delete fields. Use an expression such as a Boolean attribute set by the data view's microflow for a role check, or false so users only fill in values. Values follow the Editable setting of each task.

property.caption: Most fields
property.description: The most custom fields one plan can have, 1 to 100.

property.caption: First-time hint
property.description: Shows a short hint next to the add column button while a plan has no fields yet, until the user adds one or dismisses it.

property.caption: On fields changed
property.description: Runs on the data view object after the user added, changed or deleted a field and Fields holds the new JSON. Use it to commit the object, for example a microflow with a Commit action; without it the definitions are only saved when the page saves the object.

property.caption: On field values changed
property.description: Runs on a task after the user changed one of its custom field values and the new JSON is set. When it is empty, On task changed runs instead.

property.caption: Zoom
property.description: The scale the chart opens with. Users can switch with the toolbar buttons or Ctrl and the mouse wheel.

property.caption: Today line
property.description: Draws a line at the current date and time.

property.caption: Today line style
property.description: Line: a solid line. Dashed with label: a dashed line with the Today text at the top.

property.caption: Shade weekends
property.description: Shades Saturdays and Sundays at the day and week zoom levels.

property.caption: Look
property.description: Portfolio: slim bars in tall rows, group headings in capitals without summary bars, and quieter bar labels. Made for a timeline of projects rather than a detailed plan.

property.caption: Bar label
property.description: The text after each bar. Finish and progress shows the end date in Bar label date format and the percentage done, such as 05.2027 · 45 %. Custom uses Bar label text.

property.caption: Bar label text
property.description: The text after each bar when Bar label is Custom.

property.caption: Bar label date format
property.description: The date pattern for Finish and progress: dd day, MM month number, MMM month name, yy or yyyy year, such as MM.yyyy or MMM yyyy. Empty uses the date format of the app.

property.caption: Baseline style
property.description: Bar: a thin bar under the task. Dashed outline: a dashed frame around the baseline dates, so a late task sticks out of its frame.

property.caption: Deadline style
property.description: Flag: a thin line with a flag. Diamond: a diamond on the row, such as a business need date.

property.caption: Bar legend
property.description: Explains the bars under the chart: progress, remaining, baseline and deadline (texts Legend progress, Legend remaining, Legend baseline and Legend deadline) and each Status colour that has a legend text. The progress and remaining swatches use the first Status colour, so list the normal colour first.

property.caption: Dependency arrows
property.description: Draws finish-to-start arrows between tasks. Needs the Key and Depends on attributes.

property.caption: Critical path
property.description: Highlights the chain of dependent tasks that decides the end date. Off and On add a toolbar button that toggles it, starting hidden or shown; None removes the button. Needs the Key and Depends on attributes.

property.caption: Status date line
property.description: Draws a dashed line at the status date, the date progress is reported against.

property.caption: Highlight behind schedule
property.description: Colours the bars of tasks whose progress is below what is expected at the status date (the share of their working time before it), and shows a legend. Needs Progress.

property.caption: Status date
property.description: Optional date progress is measured against, for example $currentObject/StatusDate on the surrounding data view or a fixed date. Empty uses the start of today.

property.caption: Animations
property.description: Smooth zoom changes, bars that grow in and dependency arrows that draw in on load, a gentle highlight of a task's dependency chain on hover, and smooth scrolling to today. Always off for users who ask their system for reduced motion.

property.caption: Motion
property.description: How lively the chart is when Animations is on: Full, Subtle (short fades instead of growing bars, drawing arrows and count-ups) or Off. The operating system setting to reduce motion always switches animations off.

property.caption: Total float
property.description: Draws a thin tail behind each bar up to the latest date it can finish without moving the end of the plan, and adds Total float to the tooltip. Computed from the dependencies (all types and lags) and the working calendar. Needs Key and Depends on for meaningful values.

property.caption: Progress line
property.description: Draws a progress line: a zig-zag from the status date to the point each task's progress has reached, so tasks behind point left and tasks ahead point right. Needs Progress.

property.caption: Timeline markers
property.description: Vertical lines with a label for key dates such as a go-live, a code freeze or an audit.

property.caption: Date
property.description: The date of the marker, for example a fixed date or an attribute of the surrounding data view.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Text shown at the top of the line and read by screen readers.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Optional CSS colour of the line, for example #c4320a. Empty uses the theme's marker colour.

property.caption: Zoom to fit button
property.description: A Fit button in the toolbar (and the F key) that picks the zoom level that shows the whole plan and scrolls to its start.

property.caption: Project health
property.description: A strip above the chart with actual against planned complete at the status date, the schedule performance index (SPI), the forecast finish against the baseline finish, and the number of tasks behind schedule, on the critical path and with missed deadlines.

property.caption: Baseline shown
property.description: Name of the named baseline the chart shows when it opens; empty shows Baseline start / end when set, otherwise the latest saved baseline. Users can pick another in the Baselines panel.

property.caption: Earned value panel
property.description: A panel under the chart with budget, planned value, earned value, actual cost, the variances, CPI, SPI, estimate at and to completion and variance at completion at the status date, and an S-curve chart. Needs costs: Fixed cost or resources with cost rates.

property.caption: Cost columns
property.description: Cost and earned value columns in the task list: Cost, EV, CPI and SPI are shown, BAC, PV, AC, CV, SV, EAC, ETC and VAC can be added with the column chooser. Groups and projects show their totals. Only used while Columns is empty; otherwise add Cost and earned value columns there.

property.caption: Portfolio summary
property.description: With Project set, a table above the chart with each project's health: finish and its slip against the baseline, progress, SPI and CPI, critical, behind, missed deadlines, over-allocated tasks and cross-project links, rated on track, at risk or off track.

property.caption: Toolbar
property.description: Shows the zoom, today, group, critical path and export buttons above the chart.

property.caption: Task list
property.description: Shows the task list with name, start, end, duration and progress left of the timeline.

property.caption: Task list width
property.description: Starting width of the task list in pixels. Users can drag the splitter to change it.

property.caption: Row height
property.description: Height of one task row in pixels, 24 to 80.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Height of the chart in pixels. Rows beyond it scroll; only the rows on screen are drawn, so long plans stay fast.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Light or dark colours. Automatic follows the browser's or operating system's dark mode setting, and a dark theme class on the page (mx-theme-dark or data-theme="dark").

property.caption: Columns
property.description: The task list columns after Task name, in this order. Task name is always shown first and cannot be removed. Pick built-in columns such as Start, End and Duration or show any attribute of the task. While this list is empty the chart shows the classic columns, set with Extra columns, WBS numbers, Variance column and Cost columns.

property.caption: Column
property.description: What the column shows. Built-in columns need their attribute on the General and Planning tabs, such as Progress for Done.

property.caption: Measure
property.description: Which cost or earned value figure the column shows. Groups and projects show their totals.

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: The attribute of the task shown in the column.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Column header. Leave empty for the built-in name, such as Start; attribute columns show the attribute's name when this is empty.

property.caption: Header tooltip
property.description: Optional text shown when the pointer rests on the column header, such as what the column means.

property.caption: Format
property.description: How values are shown. Automatic uses the Mendix format of the attribute. Percent shows 45 as 45%.

property.caption: Decimals
property.description: Digits after the decimal point for Number, Currency and Percent, 0 to 6.

property.caption: Group total
property.description: What group and project rows show in this column: nothing, or the sum, average, lowest or highest value of their tasks, or how many tasks have a value. Number attributes only, except Count.

property.caption: Dynamic cell class
property.description: Optional CSS class for the cells of this column, worked out per task, such as if $currentObject/Budget < $currentObject/Spent then 'text-danger' else ''.

property.caption: Width
property.description: Starting width in pixels. 0 uses the column's own width (100 for attributes).

property.caption: Minimum width
property.description: Users cannot make the column narrower than this when they resize it, 24 to 400 pixels.

property.caption: Fill free space
property.description: The column shares the free width of the task list with Task name, so it grows when the list is widened.

property.caption: Alignment
property.description: How the text lines up. Automatic puts numbers on the right and everything else on the left.

property.caption: Wrap text
property.description: Long text wraps onto a second line (as far as the row height allows) instead of being cut off with an ellipsis.

property.caption: Shown at first
property.description: No hides the column until the user shows it with the column chooser, which needs Column chooser.

property.caption: Users can hide
property.description: No keeps the column visible: the column chooser and the header menu cannot hide it.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Users click the header to sort the tasks by this column, ascending then descending, then back to the data source order. Tasks are sorted within their groups and only in the view; nothing is saved.

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Attribute columns: users double-click a cell (or press F2 on a bar and Tab to it) to change the value. Each task's Editable still applies, and the value is saved like moved tasks, with undo. Auto numbers cannot be edited.

property.caption: Attribute name
property.description: Optional name of the attribute as in the domain model, such as Budget. Edits are written through the Mendix client, which needs the name; when this is empty it is worked out from the values, which can fail while many attributes hold the same values.

property.caption: Sortable task name
property.description: Users click the Task header to sort the tasks by name, ascending then descending, then back to the data source order.

property.caption: Extra columns
property.description: Optional extra columns in the task list, after the built-in ones, such as a status or cost. Only used while Columns is empty.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Column header.

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: The attribute shown in the column, formatted as Mendix formats it. Leave empty to use Text instead.

property.caption: Text
property.description: Text shown in the column when no attribute is set, built from the task's attributes.

property.caption: Width
property.description: Starting width of the column in pixels.

property.caption: Alignment
property.description: How the text lines up in the column.

property.caption: WBS numbers
property.description: Adds a WBS column that numbers groups and loose tasks 1, 2, 3 and the tasks in a group 1.1, 1.2. The numbers can be searched. Only used while Columns is empty; otherwise add a WBS number column there.

property.caption: Variance column
property.description: Adds a column with how many (working) days each task ends after (+) or before (-) its baseline end. Needs Baseline end. Only used while Columns is empty.

property.caption: Column chooser
property.description: Adds a Columns toolbar menu where users show or hide task list columns, including Baseline start, Baseline end, Variance and Predecessors when those attributes are set.

property.caption: Resizable columns
property.description: Lets users drag the edge of a column header (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to change the column's width.

property.caption: Remember view
property.description: Remembers collapsed groups, hidden columns and column widths per user in the browser, so the chart opens the way it was left. Uses the widget's name, so give each chart on a page its own name.

property.caption: Resource usage panel
property.description: A histogram under the chart with each resource's load as a share of its maximum units per day (or busiest day per week), over-allocated days in red and over-allocated task bars outlined. Clicking a resource highlights its tasks. Uses Assignments, or Assigned to at 100%.

property.caption: Resource levelling
property.description: A Level resources toolbar button that delays tasks until no resource is over-allocated: tasks with total float move first, higher priorities stay, started and read-only tasks never move. The result is previewed on the chart and applied as one undo step.

property.caption: Workload panel
property.description: Shows a histogram under the chart with how many tasks each person has at once, per day (day zoom) or per week (the busiest day), with over-allocation in red. Needs Assigned to.

property.caption: Tasks per person
property.description: How many tasks at the same time one person can take on; more is shown as over-allocated.

property.caption: Bar colour
property.description: Task: the Colour attribute or the default colour. Assigned to: one colour per person, so each person's work stands out; the print legend lists them.

property.caption: Search and filters
property.description: Adds a search box and Critical only, Late only and My tasks toggles to the toolbar. Late means unfinished after its end date or ending after its baseline end.

property.caption: My name
property.description: The current user as they appear in Assigned to, for the My tasks toggle, for example a parameter with $currentUser/Name or a full name from an account object. Empty hides the toggle.

property.caption: Export
property.description: Adds toolbar buttons to save the chart as a PNG image and to print it.

property.caption: File name
property.description: Name of the saved image and exported files, without an extension such as .png, .csv, .xlsx or .xml.

property.caption: CSV export
property.description: Adds an Export CSV toolbar button that saves the task list as shown (filtered, all groups expanded) in a CSV file Excel opens directly, with ISO dates and plain numbers.

property.caption: Excel export
property.description: Adds an Export to Excel toolbar button that saves the task list as shown as an .xlsx workbook: groups as bold summary rows with their tasks outlined under them, WBS numbers, real dates and numbers, duration in (working) days, progress, predecessors, assignees and baseline variance, with a frozen header row and filters.

property.caption: MS Project export
property.description: Adds an Export to MS Project toolbar button that saves the plan as Microsoft Project XML (MSPDI), which Microsoft Project and ProjectLibre open: the working calendar, groups as summary tasks, predecessor links with their type and lag, baselines, and resources with their assignments.

property.caption: Print title and legend
property.description: Prints (and saves as PDF from the print dialog) with a title, the date range and a legend of the bar types and colours above the chart, on landscape pages.

property.caption: Print title
property.description: Title printed above the chart with Print title and legend. Empty uses the file name.

property.caption: Toolbar
property.description: Default: Gantt chart commands.

property.caption: Zoom
property.description: Default: Zoom.

property.caption: Zoom Day
property.description: Default: Day.

property.caption: Zoom Week
property.description: Default: Week.

property.caption: Zoom Month
property.description: Default: Month.

property.caption: Zoom Quarter
property.description: Default: Quarter.

property.caption: Zoom Year
property.description: Default: Year.

property.caption: Today
property.description: Default: Today.

property.caption: Expand All
property.description: Default: Expand all.

property.caption: Collapse All
property.description: Default: Collapse all.

property.caption: Critical Path
property.description: Default: Critical path.

property.caption: Export Png
property.description: Default: Save as image.

property.caption: Print
property.description: Default: Print.

property.caption: Undo
property.description: Default: Undo.

property.caption: Redo
property.description: Default: Redo.

property.caption: Add Task
property.description: Default: Add task.

property.caption: Delete Task
property.description: Default: Delete task.

property.caption: Auto Schedule
property.description: Default: Auto-schedule.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Default: Columns.

property.caption: Export CSV
property.description: Default: Export CSV.

property.caption: Shortcuts
property.description: Default: Keyboard shortcuts.

property.caption: Load More
